refinement.content:
# Scratch Work
- Agree mechanisms/criteria overlap creates inefficiency
- Case study scope unsustainable within word limit
- Need tighter theoretical-empirical integration
- Current structure disperses related content
- Methodology section could better scaffold later development
- Resource constraints suggest unified treatment of mechanisms/criteria

# Framework Support Analysis
Main Thesis:
- Unified mechanisms/criteria section better supports core claims
- Shorter examples still demonstrate key points while preserving space
- Tighter integration maintains philosophical depth

Core Contribution:
- Streamlined structure enhances theoretical framework development
- More space for empirical grounding strengthens novelty claim
- Better balance between theoretical and practical elements

Key Moves:
- Revised structure maintains all key argumentative moves
- Better supports empirical integration throughout
- More efficient progression between moves

Literature:
- Methodology section better leverages Patten framework
- More space for empirical support throughout
- Better theoretical foundation development

# Refinement Decisions
## Will Implement
1. Merge mechanisms and criteria into unified framework section
- Reduces redundancy
- Creates clearer development path
- Better supports empirical integration

2. Replace case study with targeted examples
- More feasible within word constraints
- Still demonstrates practical application
- Maintains theoretical focus

3. Strengthen methodology section
- Better scaffolds later development
- Clearer connection to framework
- Supports theoretical foundation

4. Add explicit empirical integration points
- Better supports abstract promises
- Strengthens overall argument
- Maintains philosophical depth

## Won't Implement
1. Complete restructuring of theoretical foundation
- Current approach working well
- Supports key moves effectively
- Maintains philosophical depth

2. Removal of resource optimization focus
- Central to argument
- Well-supported by structure
- Key to practical application

### B. Mechanisms and Implementation Criteria

### B. Implementation Challenges

- Practical applications

## V. Conclusion

- Practical implications
- Future research directions

- Unified treatment of mechanisms/criteria strengthens theoretical development
- Better empirical integration throughout
- Maintains philosophical depth while improving practical relevance

Structural Coherence:
- Clearer progression from theory to practice
- Better integration of related concepts
- More efficient use of space

Development Feasibility:
- More realistic scope for word limit

Key Moves Support:

- Better empirical grounding
- More efficient progression
- Stronger theoretical foundation
